Diagnosis.submission: The frontend-proxy deployment was updated to a new revision (revision 2) that replaces the original proxy with a simplified Perl-based TCP proxy script. This new revision adds WAF rule evaluation (WAF_RULE_REGEX and WAF_RULE_ENABLED environment variables) and only forwards requests to the frontend service. The original frontend-proxy (revision 1) did not have these WAF rules. Additionally, during startup, the product-catalog service experienced a restart due to a race condition with PostgreSQL initialization, and the frontend logged a transient ECONNREFUSED error connecting to the checkout service. The primary fault is the frontend-proxy being modified to include WAF rules in its request handling path.
